# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM and WinUI fixes**

## Highlights

This unreleased head backports Apple 26.0 library support and fixes a WinUI projection DLL resolution bug.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 backport** — Backports the Apple 26.0 native library and unversioned app TFM support to the 3.119.x line. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI projection DLL resolved for .NET 9** — Fixes a missing WinUI Projection DLL that broke .NET 9 consumers. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
